reviewer.route: Oracle Browser / logged-in ChatGPT Agent project

core_assessment: A potentially real paper remains. The defensible completed result is local state-regeneration instability consistent with a state-generation bottleneck, not a diagnosis of population state-generation variance. The residual novelty is the matched-evidence intervention at the state-generation realization, not failure feedback, diagnosis-to-repair, or persistent knowledge decomposition.
verdict_changing_actions: Narrow title and claims from state-generation variance/localization to state-regeneration instability or candidate bottleneck unless repeated same-evidence synthesis plus fixed-state actor replication is added.

Retarget the smallest pre-M4 actor-noise experiment to frozen remeasurement of the historical First-Fail state, fresh First-Fail realization 1, fresh First-Fail realization 2, and one common frozen WIN-C comparator; no new updater call is necessary.
Repair M4 authority hierarchy so a positive matched-evidence generator effect can enter validation independently of First-Fail source superiority and the Evidence x Generator interaction.
Add a trajectory-blind state-scope-matched generic control in addition to SCORE_ONLY_GENERIC_MAX before attributing benefit to trajectory-conditioned diagnosis.

If regeneration/reproducibility remains a central contribution, add exactly one additional same-evidence FREE synthesis per fresh validation stream plus fixed-state actor remeasurement; otherwise describe COMP-vs-FREE only as a complete generation-method effect.
Predeclare that failure of the corrected fresh generator gate or failure to beat the scope-matched generic control stops the paper without E3, another backbone, or another benchmark rescue.
important_nonblockers: The Evidence x Generator factorial itself is scientifically appropriate under matched learner-visible inputs.
First-Fail-4 equalizes replacement count, not information dose; it is an evidence-package-policy contrast.
State length/scope and free-form stochasticity do not invalidate the total complete-method COMP-vs-FREE effect, but they limit semantic-diagnosis and variance claims.
The paper can remain top-tier viable if the generator effect validates while First-Fail source superiority and interaction fail; that would yield a cleaner state-generation-method paper.
stop_condition: Stop rather than expand if constrained state generation does not show a reproducible positive matched-evidence advantage on fresh streams, or if any apparent advantage is matched by the trajectory-blind scope-matched generic control.
